body: The problem with foldable dynamic sections is that it does not work, because when you fold a 3 column wide dynamic section on a board with 9 columns the 6 columns behind it are still there and use the full size. It would only work for rows where you only have dynamic sections. Or do you have an idea how to deal with this?

Regarding the title, I already thought about adding more customizabilities of dynamic sections like custom border colors and titles. IMO something like the following for title would be a good way:

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d7fddd02-bfb6-459f-9802-4ea1ef3246e0)

What do you think?

Title like that would be fantastic, especially if the font size scales with size, or can be adjusted manually (latter is preferrable, but will probably break stuff if hard fixed when people resize via UI?).
Border settings would be nice to have too, and if we're talking re nice-to-haves - opacity setting / slider per item would be amazing for my personal style preference, but I can of course manage it personally via CSS on my side. At least having a custom CSS class option in 'Advanced options' maybe?

Regarding the column collapse - I was thinking about something like Dashy handles it, see screenshots:
![dash1](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/05b7d365-739a-432f-bab4-f97f6b5a1f2a)
![dash2](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4a1c91f2-e5a3-49cc-ac2a-6cfd778f0d5d)

I mean, it's already grid-based, so might as well? I tend to lean towards a 'cleaner' look personally, so if some sections aren't important to me, say, this week - I'd collapse them for a cleaner look
@Meierschlumpf did you start to work on it?
